lesson.summary:
Past simple dipakai untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lalu, sering dengan keterangan waktu seperti *yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago*.

Kebanyakan kata kerja cukup ditambah *-ed*: *work → worked, visit → visited, stop → stopped*. Kata kerja tidak beraturan punya bentuk sendiri yang harus dihafal: *go → went, buy → bought, see → saw, eat → ate, teach → taught*.

Untuk kalimat tanya dan negatif, pakai *did/didn't* + kata kerja bentuk dasar: *Did you see the news? I didn't sleep well.* Karena penanda lampaunya sudah ada di *did*, kata kerja berikutnya tidak diubah lagi (bukan *didn't went*).

Bentuk lampau *be* adalah *was* (untuk *I, he, she, it*) dan *were* (untuk *you, we, they*). Kalimat tanya dan negatifnya tidak memakai *did*: *Were you at home? It wasn't expensive.*

Bahasa Indonesia cukup memakai kata seperti "kemarin" atau "tadi" tanpa mengubah kata kerja. Dalam bahasa Inggris, kata kerjanya juga harus berubah.

patterns.example: We visited Lake Toba. She bought a phone.
Did you go to the party?

patterns.formula: I / he / she / it + was; you / we / they + were
patterns.example: The film was boring. We were tired.

examples.en: We visited Lake Toba last year.
examples.id: Kami mengunjungi Danau Toba tahun lalu.

examples.en: Dewi bought a new phone yesterday.
I didn't sleep well last night.
examples.id: Saya tidak tidur nyenyak tadi malam.

examples.en: My grandfather taught at a village school for thirty years.
examples.id: Kakek saya mengajar di sekolah desa selama tiga puluh tahun.

examples.en: The film was boring, so we left early.
examples.id: Filmnya membosankan, jadi kami pulang lebih awal.

commonMistakes.wrong: Yesterday I go to the market.
commonMistakes.right: Yesterday I went to the market.
commonMistakes.why: Kata kerja harus berubah ke bentuk lampau. Kata *yesterday* saja tidak cukup.
Setelah *did*, pakai bentuk dasar (*see*), bukan bentuk lampau.
Setelah *didn't*, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar.

questions.explanation: Kata kerja beraturan: visit → visited.
Kata kerja tidak beraturan: buy → bought.
Negatif lampau: didn't + bentuk dasar (sleep).
Pertanyaan lampau: Did + subjek + bentuk dasar.

questions.sentence: The film {{1}} boring, so we {{2}} early.
questions.explanation: be → was (the film = it). leave → left.

questions.sentence: Where {{1}} last night? I called you twice.
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan be tidak memakai did: Where were you?

questions.sentence: My grandfather {{1}} at a village school for thirty years.
questions.explanation: teach → taught. Masa mengajarnya sudah selesai.

questions.sentence: When I was a child, I {{1}} vegetables.
questions.explanation: Masa kecil sudah lewat: didn't like.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
segments: to the market and bought some fish.
questions.corrected: Yesterday I went to the market and bought some fish.
questions.explanation: Kejadian kemarin: go → went.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.explanation: Setelah did, pakai bentuk dasar: see.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: She didn't come to class today.
questions.explanation: Setelah didn't, pakai bentuk dasar: come.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: We were very tired after the trip.
questions.explanation: Subjek we memakai were.
When + did + subjek + bentuk dasar.
Negatif: didn't + bentuk dasar (see).
get married → got married. Tahun memakai in.

questions.hint: Apa yang kamu makan tadi pagi?
questions.explanation: What + did + subjek + bentuk dasar (eat).

questions.sentence: Last night I ___ a strange dream.

options.why: last night menunjukkan masa lalu, jadi perlu bentuk lampau.
have tidak beraturan, jadi tidak ada bentuk haved.

questions.explanation: have adalah kata kerja tidak beraturan: had.

options.why: Benar. your trip = it, jadi pakai was.
did perlu diikuti kata kerja lain. Di sini kata kerjanya be.
were untuk you/we/they atau benda jamak.

questions.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan be di masa lalu: How was …? / Where were …?

questions.sentence: They ___ the bus because they woke up late.

options.why: Kalimatnya tentang masa lalu (woke up), jadi perlu bentuk lampau.
were tidak digabung dengan bentuk dasar kata kerja.

questions.explanation: Kejadian yang sudah selesai: past simple.
